info.name: search users for their identity details

params.name: bearerToken
params.description: Bearer token for Auth0 authentication

params.name: assetId
params.description: Query string to search for users.

params.name: page
params.description: Page index of the results to return. First page is 0.

params.name: perPage
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 50.

params.name: totals
params.description: If true, the query will return the total number of items that match.

params.name: sort
params.description: The field to use for sorting. Use `field:1` for ascending order and `field:-1` for descending order.

params.name: connection
params.description: The name of the connection to use for the search.

params.name: fields
params.description: A comma-separated list of fields to include or exclude from the result. Eg. "user_id,email,email_verified". Leave empty to retrieve all fields.

params.name: includeFields
params.description: Whether to include or exclude the fields specified in the `fields` parameter. Defaults to true.

params.name: searchEngine
params.description: The version of the search engine to use. Defaults to "v3".
